question: Accenture summer internship interview (HR + technical, about 20 minutes). After questions on project learnings, impact and problems faced, the candidate said they were familiar with Java and was asked: **what is the difference between an abstract class and an interface?** The interviewer also said to expect basic OOP questions.
lookingFor: Core OOP concepts: abstraction, inheritance, polymorphism.
Precise Java knowledge, including modern interface features.
Judgement about when to use which.
Ability to explain with a short example.
followUps: Can an interface have a constructor? Why not?
Can an abstract class have no abstract methods?
What is the diamond problem and how does Java handle it?
